name: Speed Up Your Plant Growth
description:
Fertilizer is a foundational resource to produce and consume when farming. It has two key uses:

First, it speeds up crop growth by boosting the nutrient score.

Second, it prevents stat loss during crop breeding. This simply prevents stat loss; it doesn't increase the likelihood of a stat increase.

Four separate items can be used to apply fertilizer to your crops, each providing a different amount of fertilizer points:

- Crops NH Fertilizer: 100 points
- Forestry Compost: 50 points
- Forestry Fertilizer: 25 points
- Bone Meal: 5 points

[note]While Bone Meal may seem weak, its ability to still prevent stat loss when breeding is key if you intend to start crops before you can make a Chemical Reactor.[/note]

The Crop Managers and the Industrial Farm both also accept liquid fertilizers. There are currently two of them:

- Fertilizer: 1 point per L
- Enriched Fertilizer: 10 points per L
